A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Senator stole a [[Khil heirloom|heirloom]] that was sacred to Belnar's native [[Khil]] [[Species/Legends|species]], but he was tracked down by an investigator and tricked into confessing the crime.<ref name="Senatorial Search" />
